title: Hegseth warns prediction market bets warp military judgment, endanger troops
summary: Pentagon memo: Insider trading gives US enemies key intel on military operations.
llm_summary: A Pentagon memo warns that prediction‑market platforms—where people bet on the outcome of military operations—are effectively creating a new form of insider trading. By buying or selling contracts based on classified information, hostile actors can glean real‑time intel about U.S. missions, potentially skewing commanders’ judgments and putting troops at risk.
